grammar.k: 一般现在时与现在进行时的对比 (Simple Present vs Present Continuous)
grammar.f: 主语 + usually + 动词原形/三单形式... but + 主语 + am/is/are + 动词-ing + 时间状语
grammar.d: 一般现在时表示习惯性、经常性的动作；现在进行时表示此刻正在进行的动作。通过对比两者，可以描述某一天发生的事情与平时的不同。 用于描述某人通常做某事，但今天/此刻正在做另一件事
ex: The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
孩子们每天乘汽车去上学，但今天他们步行去上学。
Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night. But tonight, he's reading an interesting book.
索耶先生通常在晚上看报纸。但今晚他在读一本有趣的书。

grammar.d: 使用具体的钟点时间来标记一天中不同时间段发生的事情 用于引出不同时间点发生的事情，常与现在进行时连用
ex: It is eight o'clock. The children are going to school on foot.
现在是八点。孩子们正在步行去上学。
It is six o'clock. The children are playing in the garden.
现在是六点。孩子们正在花园里玩耍。

patterns.p: It is + 时间. + 主语 usually + 动词..., but + 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing + 时间.
o: It is four o'clock. Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room. But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
现在是四点。索耶太太通常在客厅喝茶。但今天下午她在花园里喝茶。
im: It is seven o'clock. Tom usually eats dinner at home. But tonight, he is eating dinner at a restaurant.
现在是七点。汤姆通常在家吃晚饭。但今晚他在餐厅吃晚饭。
It is nine o'clock. Lisa usually sleeps early, but tonight she is watching TV.
现在是九点。莉莎通常早睡，但今晚她在看电视。

patterns.p: At the moment, 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing...
o: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
此刻，他们正在花园里玩耍。
im: At the moment, she is reading a book.
At the moment, he is cooking dinner.

patterns.p: 主语 + usually + 动词..., but + 主语 + be动词 + not + 动词-ing...
o: In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
晚上，孩子们通常做家庭作业，但今晚他们没在做家庭作业。
im: Usually, I watch TV in the evening, but today I am not watching TV.
通常我晚上看电视，但今天我没在看。
He usually works late, but today he is not working.
他通常工作到很晚，但今天他没在工作。

patterns.p: 主语 + usually + 动词原形/三单形式 + 时间状语. But + 主语 + be动词 + 动词-ing + tonight/today/this...
o: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night. But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
索耶先生通常在晚上看报纸。但今晚他没在看报纸。
im: I usually drink coffee in the morning. But this morning I am drinking tea.
我通常早上喝咖啡。但今天早上我在喝茶。
She usually wears a dress, but today she is wearing trousers.
她通常穿连衣裙，但今天她穿着裤子。
